P4649.facts: The NDRC 2023 PipeChina tariff notice's 川气东送 row explicitly lists 江西支线 among this trunk's branches ('达化专线、川维支线、南京支线、江西支线、武石化支线、西一线联络线等'), alongside the trunk's 四川达州→上海青浦 termini. Supports, for the Jiangxi branch row: operator = 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 (PipeChina, which charges the regulated tariff), Status = operating, PipelineType = transmission, Fuel = Gas, and the branch's parentage under 川气东送. Names the branch by name, so it clears the RELEVANCE rule for those cells — but it carries NO length, diameter, capacity, pressure or date for the branch.

新华网 via people.com.cn (2019) states the trunk's gas sources (普光气田、涪陵页岩气、元坝气田) and the 洋山港 LNG receipt — the upstream supply that feeds every 川气东送 branch, usable as FuelSource context for the Jiangxi branch beside a branch-naming source (system-level for that row, so cap at low unless the branch is named).

P4661.facts: 央视新闻 via 央广网, 2025-08-25, on 川气东送二线 (the parent system of P4661's 皖赣支干线): total length ~4269 km, 起于四川泸县、止于浙江温州, built in two phases (四川重庆湖北段; 湖北河南江西安徽浙江福建段), 预计2027年全面建成; the FIRST section entered service on 2025-08-25 (安岳气田上载点 → 重庆铜梁压气站, 56.15 km, adding ~30亿立方米/年). Bears on P4661's owed Start/Construction fills: the 二线 east段 (which contains 皖赣支干线) is NOT yet in service and is scheduled for 2027.

MEE approval (2025-01-06) of the EIA for 川气东送二线天然气管道工程鄂豫赣皖浙闽段 — 干线、枣阳-宣城联络线、芜湖联络线、浙闽支干线. This is the central-government EIA 批复 covering the Jiangxi/Anhui reach that P4661's 皖赣支干线 sits in; a companion 批复 (t20250106_1100015.html) covers the 川渝鄂段(二阶段), and pipechina.com.cn/front/tzgg/3002806.html + /3003826.html are the operator's own EIA disclosures for the 川渝鄂段(三阶段). Primary-source ladder for P4661's Construction/Start/route specs; nea.gov.cn (2025-02-21) states the east段 is 全长2698公里, 设计压力10兆帕, 年设计输量140亿立方米 — a SYSTEM figure for the east section, not P4661's segment spec.

PipeChina's own announcement that 川气东送二线 formally broke ground (正式开工) on 2023-09-16 (also carried by gmw.cn/2023-09/16/content_36836546.htm and sasac.gov.cn c28876484) — the construction-start milestone for the 二线 rows, which P4661 owes as a Construction fill. Verify the page before staging; I read the search result, not the page body.

Same table also gives 定南一龙南 35.9, 龙南→信丰 27.5, 安远一定南 73.4, 安远一寻乌 45.5, 会昌一安远 80.4, 宁都一广昌 80, 广昌-南丰 72.5, 西二线瑞金一会昌 51.3, 西一线瑞金-石城 43.6, 西二线于都宁都 58.5, 西一线于都一于都 33.1, 赣州南康 17, 安义一湾里一昌北 41 — useful planning-length candidates (medium at best; one origin, and the 龙南一全南 24.6 entry proves these are notional pre-EIA figures) for the other Jiangxi county rows. NOTE: the 2024 operator plan's four branches do NOT include 大余-信丰, so P4785 is outside that approval.

Two things for whoever holds the Dayu-Xinfeng row. (1) The quannan 2024 plan's four Ganzhou-south branches are 信丰-瑞金段, 龙南-全南段, 会昌－寻乌段 and 上犹-崇义段 -- 大余-信丰段 is NOT one of them, so the 217,260万元 four-branch approval does not cover it; 大余-信丰段 is listed separately as item 14 赣州南支线（大余 -信丰段）in Jiangxi's 2021 key-projects list https://www.sohu.com/a/466792472_661255, and the 2014 provincial plan (赣发改规划[2014]325号) gives 大余-信丰 as 36 km. (2) UNASSIGNED SIBLING: the 上犹-崇义段 branch (43 km per the plan's prose, DN250, 6.3 MPa, 0.9×10^8 Nm3/a; item 24 上犹 -崇义段 in the 2021 list) -- if a GEM row exists for it, note that table 3-8 of the plan MIS-PRINTS its length as 97.5 km (copying the 会昌-寻乌段 row); the prose figure 43 km is the correct one. (3) jxnews https://tt.jxnews.com.cn/news/1266077 says the 瑞金分输站 feeds 会昌、寻乌、安远、定南、龙南、全南、信丰、大余 (8 counties) off 赣州南支线 and that WEP2's 149# valve chamber at Dayu is the second gas source -- relevant to any Dayu row's FuelSource.
